Adjusted Net Loss Per Share • Adjusted net loss per share for the third quarter was $(0.48) compared to $(0.65) for the same quarter of the prior year . Production and Deliveries • 19,751 vehicles produced at Rivian’s manufacturing facility in Normal, Illinois. • 19,248 vehicles delivered to customers. Revenues • Consolidated revenue was $2.155 billion, a 38 percent increase over the same quarter of the prior year . This was driven by a 46 percent year-over-year increase in delivery volumes, $81 million in revenues related to regulatory credits, and strong performance from the company’s software and services segment. ◦ Automotive revenue was $1.550 billion, a 36 percent increase over the same quarter of the prior year , primarily due to the increase in vehicle deliveries and an $80 million increase in revenues related to regulatory credits, which were partially offset by a decline in average vehicle selling price due to a higher mix of R2 and commercial van deliveries. ◦ Software and services revenue was $605 million, a 45 percent increase over the same quarter of the prior year , primarily due to increases in vehicle electrical architecture and software development services, vehicle repair and maintenance services, and Autonomy+, partially offset by lower remarketing sales. $354 million or 59 percent of software and services revenue was attributable to the company’s joint venture with Volkswagen Group. Gross Profit • Consolidated gross profit was $176 million, a $152 million improvement over the same quarter of the prior year . ◦ Automotive gross profit loss for the third quarter was $(80) million compared to $(130) million in the same quarter of the prior year , a $50 million improvement primarily resulting from increases in delivery volumes at an improved per unit margin, an increase in revenues related to regulatory credits, and an IEEPA tariff refund receivable, partially offset by costs related to the ramp of R2 production. In the quarter, Rivian recognized approximately $120 million in incremental cost of revenues due to the ramp of R2 production as compared to production at more normalized levels. ◦ Software and services gross profit for the third quarter was $256 million, a 42 percent margin and $102 million improvement over the same quarter of the prior year at $154 million, primarily due to increases in vehicle electrical architecture and software development services from the joint venture with Volkswagen Group and Autonomy+. Operating Expenses and Operating Loss • Total operating expenses in the third quarter increased to $1.057 billion compared to $1.007 billion in the same quarter of the prior year . ◦ Research and development (R&D) expenses were $485 million compared to $453 million in the same quarter of the prior year . The increase was primarily driven by increases in software expenses to support AI and autonomy initiatives , partially offset by a reduction in engineering, design, and development spend . ◦ Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses remained relatively consistent at $572 million compared to $554 million in the same quarter of the prior year . • For the third quarter, the company experienced a loss from operations of $(881) million compared to $(983) million in the same quarter of the prior year , a $102 million improvement.
